title: What’s Your Bluey Adventure Personality?
description: Answer 12 questions to discover your Bluey adventure personality!

questions.text: When planning a backyard game with Bluey and Bingo, you would…

options.text: Invent a brand new game with wild, imaginative rules no one’s ever played before
Prefer to watch and help only if someone asks for your input
Invite all the neighborhood kids to join in, making sure everyone has a role
Stick to a familiar game you know Bluey and Bingo love most

questions.text: When Bluey accidentally breaks your favorite toy, you would…

options.text: Get excited immediately, ready to jump in the car without knowing any plans
Focus on fixing it with whatever supplies you can find around the house
Decide to put it aside and follow a pre-planned activity you had scheduled
Hug Bluey and say it’s okay—you care more about her feelings than the toy

questions.text: Mum suggests a surprise day trip—you would…

options.text: Talk about all the fun things you could do along the way, brainstorming new stops
Ask for all the details: where you’re going, what time you’ll leave, and what snacks to bring
Spend a few minutes daydreaming about the quiet moments you might have on the trip
Get excited immediately, ready to jump in the car without knowing any plans

questions.text: When playing “Restaurant” with Bluey as the chef, you would…

options.text: Write down your order neatly and quietly pass it to Bluey without drawing attention
Order a meal that combines the most unusual, creative ingredients you can think of
Make sure to compliment Bluey’s cooking loudly so everyone at the “restaurant” hears
Order the same simple meal you always get when you go out to eat

questions.text: Your friend is feeling sad because they lost a game of “Grannies”—you would…

options.text: Explain logically why the game rules meant they couldn’t win, helping them understand
Come up with a structured plan to practice the game with them until they master it
Sit with them and share a story about a time you lost a game and felt the same way
Suggest starting a new, simpler game where everyone can win easily

questions.text: Dad suggests building a fort in the living room—you would…

options.text: Add secret tunnels, hidden compartments, and a “treasure room” using extra blankets and pillows
Go with the flow, using whatever materials are nearby without any fixed plan
Use the exact materials Dad recommends, following his step-by-step instructions carefully
Invite Bingo and Bluey to help, assigning each of them a specific job to keep everyone busy

questions.text: When you have a free afternoon, you would rather…

options.text: Spend time alone reading a book about animals or drawing pictures of your favorite Bluey episodes
Join Bluey and Bingo on their latest adventure, no matter where it takes you
Bake cookies with Mum, making sure to measure every ingredient perfectly
Daydream about a magical world where you can talk to all the characters from Bluey

questions.text: When a storm cancels your planned trip to the park, you would…

options.text: Create a list of indoor activities you can do, checking them off one by one as you go
Build a pillow fort and listen to Mum tell stories about when she was a kid
Get everyone together to act out a storm-themed play with silly costumes and dialogues
Invent a pretend “storm chase” game where you explore the house for hidden “safe spots”

questions.text: Bluey asks you to help her teach Bingo a new trick—you would…

options.text: Let Bingo try the trick in her own way, adjusting as she goes without pressure
Break the trick into small, easy steps so Bingo can follow along slowly
Show Bingo exactly how to do the trick once, then let her practice on her own
Encourage Bingo by cheering loudly every time she makes even a small attempt

questions.text: When choosing a movie to watch with the Heelers, you would…

options.text: Pick a brand new animated film no one has seen yet, eager to explore a new story
Ask everyone to vote on their top pick, making sure the majority wins
Choose the classic Heeler family favorite everyone knows by heart
Let someone else choose, happy to watch whatever everyone else wants

questions.text: You find a lost puppy in the backyard—you would…

options.text: Sit with the puppy and comfort it, talking softly to make it feel safe until help arrives
Take the puppy inside, give it water, and make a sign to hang around the neighborhood to find its owner
Play with the puppy first, then figure out what to do next as things unfold
Follow a step-by-step plan from a pet care book to make sure the puppy is taken care of properly

questions.text: When planning a birthday party for Bluey, you would…

options.text: Go with whatever Bluey feels like doing that day, changing plans as she gets new ideas
Keep the party small with just Bluey’s closest friends, focusing on her favorite activities
Make a detailed schedule for the party, including cake time, games, and gift opening in order
Invite every friend Bluey has, planning games that get everyone up and interacting

results.title: Neighborhood Adventure Leader (ENFJ)
results.description: Like the most popular kid in the neighborhood, you thrive on bringing everyone together. You plan epic games that make even shy kids feel included, remember everyone’s favorite snacks, and turn ordinary afternoons into unforgettable adventures. You’re an ENFJ—warm, charismatic, and always ready to lift others up, just like Bluey when she organizes group play.

results.title: Wild Game Inventor (ENTP)
results.description: You’re the master of weird, wonderful games no one’s ever heard of—think “Pizza Tag with a dragon twist” or “Underwater Treasure Hunt in the bathtub.” You love challenging the rules, laughing at silly mistakes, and turning boredom into chaos (the fun kind!). As an ENTP, you’re curious, clever, and never short on imaginative ideas to keep Bluey and Bingo entertained.

results.title: Structured Play Organizer (ESTJ)
results.description: You believe every game needs clear rules and a fair plan. When playing “Grannies,” you make sure everyone follows the rules exactly, and when building a fort, you assign specific jobs to keep things running smoothly. You’re an ESTJ—reliable, organized, and the go-to person for making sure playtime is fair and fun for everyone, just like Dad when he leads backyard games.

results.title: Spontaneous Playmate (ESTP)
results.description: You live for the moment—if Bluey suggests ditching a planned game to chase a butterfly, you’re the first to run. You love physical games, silly dares, and turning everyday objects into toys. As an ESTP, you’re energetic, bold, and always up for a new challenge, making you Bingo’s favorite partner in crime when they want to break the routine.

results.title: Compassionate Companion (ESFJ)
results.description: You notice when Bingo is feeling left out during a game, and you always save the last cookie for her. You thrive on making others feel loved, whether it’s helping Mum bake or listening to Bluey’s latest story. You’re an ESFJ—kind, caring, and the heart of every playgroup, just like Bingo’s best friend who always has her back.

results.title: Imaginative Storyteller (ESFP)
results.description: You turn every walk to the mailbox into a magical quest, every meal into a royal feast, and every nap into a dragon-slaying adventure. You love dressing up, making silly faces, and keeping everyone laughing. As an ESFP, you’re playful, vibrant, and the life of the party, just like Bluey when she’s in the middle of a wild, creative game.

results.title: Strategic Game Planner (ENTJ)
results.description: You don’t just play games—you win them. You study the rules, plan every move, and come up with clever strategies to make sure your team succeeds. When playing “Keepy Uppy,” you know exactly how to position yourself to hit the balloon the longest. As an ENTJ, you’re confident, goal-oriented, and always one step ahead, just like Dad when he joins in competitive play.

results.title: Quiet Dreamer (INFP)
results.description: You spend your afternoons daydreaming about magical worlds where Bluey and Bingo are dragons, or you’re a vet who talks to all the neighborhood animals. You value quiet moments, love drawing and writing stories, and feel deeply connected to the characters in Bluey. As an INFP, you’re gentle, creative, and always in touch with your inner child.

results.title: Problem-Solving Sidekick (INTP)
results.description: When the fort collapses mid-play, you’re the one who figures out how to make it stronger using physics (even if you don’t call it that). You love taking things apart to see how they work, and you come up with clever solutions to small problems. As an INTP, you’re curious, analytical, and always ready to use your smarts to help Bluey and Bingo fix their messes.

results.title: Loyal Caregiver (ISFJ)
results.description: You remember everyone’s favorite snacks, check on friends who are sad, and always have a band-aid ready when someone scrapes their knee. You find joy in taking care of others, whether it’s helping Mum cook or making sure Bingo has enough blankets during a nap. As an ISFJ, you’re warm, reliable, and the quiet hero of every playgroup, just like Bingo’s trusted companion.

results.title: Adaptive Explorer (ISTJ)
results.description: You’re the one who knows exactly where all the toys are stored, the rules of every game Bluey loves, and how to fix the broken swing in the backyard. You thrive on routine but can adapt when plans change, like turning a canceled park trip into a cozy indoor puzzle day. As an ISTJ, you’re practical, responsible, and the go-to person for keeping things on track.

results.title: Curious Observer (ISTP)
results.description: You love taking apart old toys to see how they work, building ramps for the dog to jump over, and figuring out how to make the water hose spray farther. You prefer to watch and learn before joining in, then jump in with clever ideas that surprise everyone. As an ISTP, you’re hands-on, resourceful, and always ready to turn everyday objects into something fun.

results.title: Empathetic Listener (INFJ)
results.description: You can tell when Bluey is feeling frustrated even before she says a word, and you know exactly what to say to make her feel better. You love deep conversations about dreams and feelings, and you find joy in helping others find their voice. As an INFJ, you’re intuitive, caring, and the quiet confidant who understands everyone’s unspoken needs, just like Mum when she listens to Bluey’s stories.

results.title: Free-Spirited Playmate (ISFP)
results.description: You prefer to play by your own rules—dancing in the rain, making up songs about your favorite snacks, or building forts with whatever materials are lying around. You love art, music, and the beauty of nature, and you find joy in small, simple moments. As an ISFP, you’re gentle, creative, and always ready to follow your heart, just like Bingo when she’s exploring the garden.

results.title: Creative Visionary (INTJ)
results.description: You plan months ahead for Bluey’s birthday party, coming up with a themed adventure that includes a scavenger hunt, custom decorations, and a cake shaped like a Heeler house. You love big ideas, long-term plans, and turning your dreams into reality. As an INTJ, you’re strategic, imaginative, and always thinking about the next big thing, just like Dad when he’s planning a family trip.

results.title: Laid-Back Companion (ENFP)
results.description: You’re up for anything—whether it’s playing “Mums and Dads,” chasing butterflies, or having a picnic in the living room. You love meeting new people, sharing silly jokes, and turning ordinary days into extraordinary adventures. As an ENFP, you’re enthusiastic, optimistic, and always ready to say “yes” to a new idea, just like Bluey when she invites you to join her latest game.
